title: General Control Fault
shortDescription: The oven has detected an unspecified internal error.
fullDescription: Error F00 is a generic AEG fault logged when the control detects an inconsistency not matching a more specific code. Transient F00 events often clear with a power-cycle; persistent occurrences require board-level inspection.

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Cut the breaker for 10 minutes then restore power.

fixSteps.title: Call service
fixSteps.instruction: If F00 persists, a technician must test the control board.

faq.a: Yes. Power surges regularly trigger generic faults.

title: Temperature Sensor Fault
shortDescription: The main cavity sensor is open or shorted.
fullDescription: Error F01 indicates the oven NTC/PT sensor is giving invalid readings. Heating is disabled until replaced. The sensor mounts in the rear wall of the cavity.

fixSteps.title: Cut power
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off the breaker.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew the sensor from the cavity back wall and fit a new one.

whenToCallPro: If replacement does not clear the code, the board input is at fault.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F01 sensor error fix

faq.q: Is it safe to bake with F01?
faq.a: No. The element could overheat without a valid sensor.

title: Core Temperature Probe Fault
shortDescription: The food probe is faulty or disconnected.
fullDescription: Error F02 indicates the core-temperature probe accessory is not reading correctly. Probe cooking is disabled; regular oven programs continue.

fixSteps.title: Inspect probe
fixSteps.instruction: Check the cable for kinks or cuts.

fixSteps.title: Clean the jack
fixSteps.instruction: With power off, clean the in-cavity probe socket with a cotton swab.

whenToCallPro: Rare. Only if the jack itself needs replacement inside the cavity.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F02 probe error fix

faq.q: Can I cook without the probe?
faq.a: Yes, use manual times and temperatures.

title: Door Lock Fault
shortDescription: The pyrolytic door lock did not respond as commanded.
fullDescription: Error F10 indicates the motorised door lock did not reach its commanded position. A failed motor, gear, or microswitch is the usual cause.

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Cut the breaker and wait; often the lock releases on cooldown.

fixSteps.title: Replace lock
fixSteps.instruction: Access the lock from the oven top and install a new assembly.

whenToCallPro: If the door remains locked with a hot cavity, call service to release safely.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F10 door lock error fix

faq.q: How long before the lock releases on cooldown?
faq.a: Usually within 60-90 minutes after the cavity drops below 200C.

title: Door Switch Fault
shortDescription: The oven door switch is reporting inconsistent status.
fullDescription: Error F11 indicates the door-open switch input is out of sync with the lock. A failed microswitch or a bent actuator is typical.

fixSteps.title: Check door fit
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect hinges; a sagging door can miss the switch actuator.

fixSteps.title: Replace the switch
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the front trim to reach the switch and install a new one.

whenToCallPro: If hinges are worn, a pro can replace the hinge assembly safely.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F11 door switch error fix

faq.q: Does the oven work at all?
faq.a: Often heating is disabled for safety until the switch reads correctly.

title: Convection Fan Fault
shortDescription: The hot-air convection fan is not running.
fullDescription: Error F20 indicates the rear convection fan that circulates heated air is not providing feedback or draws abnormal current. Hot-air modes are disabled.

fixSteps.title: Unplug and access
fixSteps.instruction: Cut power and remove the rear cavity panel.

fixSteps.title: Replace the motor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap the convection motor and reinstall the panel.

whenToCallPro: If wiring is damaged, a pro should assess the harness safely.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F20 convection fan error fix

faq.a: Conventional bake often works; hot-air is disabled.

title: Cooling Fan Fault
shortDescription: The tangential cooling fan is not running.
fullDescription: Error F30 indicates the cooling fan that vents the top of the oven and electronics compartment has stopped. Heating is disabled to prevent electronics overheat.

fixSteps.title: Clean vents
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum the top vent slots.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the top cover and swap the tangential fan.

whenToCallPro: If the oven is integrated and hard to pull out, a pro can remove it safely.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F30 cooling fan error fix

faq.q: Can I keep using the oven until I fix this?
faq.a: No. Running without cooling damages the electronics.

title: PCB Overtemperature
shortDescription: The control board temperature exceeded its safe limit.
fullDescription: Error F31 indicates the board-mounted temperature sensor detected overheating of the electronics. Most often caused by a failing cooling fan (F30) or cabinet ventilation blockage.

fixSteps.title: Check ventilation
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure the installation has the specified cooling gaps.

fixSteps.title: Service the cooling fan
fixSteps.instruction: Follow F30 steps to replace the tangential fan.

whenToCallPro: If F31 recurs with a working fan, call service for a board inspection.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F31 PCB overtemperature error fix

faq.q: Should I open cabinet doors while baking?
faq.a: No, but ensure the installation meets AEG's ventilation specs.

title: Keypad / Touch Panel Fault
shortDescription: The user interface has detected a stuck key or panel fault.
fullDescription: Error F41 indicates a key has been reported pressed for too long or the touch panel is returning invalid data. Spills and cracked glass are common causes.

fixSteps.title: Clean the panel
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and wipe the panel dry.

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Leave off for five minutes before restoring.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning does not clear F41, the touch module needs replacement.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F41 keypad error fix

faq.q: Can oven cleaner damage the panel?
faq.a: Yes — never spray cleaner onto the control panel.

title: Communication Error
fullDescription: Error F50 indicates the user interface and the power board cannot communicate over the internal bus. A loose ribbon or a failing board is typical.

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Cut the breaker for five minutes.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ribbons
fixSteps.instruction: Open the control panel and reseat the ribbon at both ends.

whenToCallPro: If reseating does not clear F50, a board replacement is likely needed.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F50 communication error fix

faq.a: Yes, surges frequently trigger communication faults.

title: Relay Mismatch
shortDescription: A heating relay did not switch as commanded.
fullDescription: Error F60 indicates a mismatch between the relay command and the current-sense feedback. Often a welded or open relay, or a failed driver transistor.
symptoms: Oven will not heat when commanded

fixSteps.title: Cut power
fixSteps.instruction: Shut the breaker — possible runaway relay.

fixSteps.title: Call service
fixSteps.instruction: A technician must inspect and replace the board.

whenToCallPro: Always. Relay runaway is a fire risk.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F60 relay error fix

faq.q: Can I use the oven briefly?

title: Overvoltage Detected
shortDescription: The mains voltage is above the safe operating range.
fullDescription: Error F61 indicates the mains voltage monitored by the control board has exceeded the safe operating range. The oven disables all heating until the voltage returns to normal.

fixSteps.title: Check other appliances
fixSteps.instruction: If lights flicker unusually bright, call the utility immediately.

fixSteps.title: Call an electrician
fixSteps.instruction: Have the branch circuit and neutral inspected.

whenToCallPro: Always. Overvoltage can damage multiple appliances; prompt inspection is required.
videoSearchQuery: AEG oven F61 overvoltage error fix

faq.a: Oven damage from utility faults is usually not covered — homeowner insurance may help.
